stories.title: S. Korea Claims 3 Golds in Fencing, Esports, Basketball with Wins over Japan

en.title: S. Korea Claims 3 Golds in Fencing, Esports, Basketball with Wins over Japan
en.summary: South Korea won three gold medals at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Saturday, defeating Japan in fencing, esports, and basketball. The men's sabre fencing team secured victory with a narrow 45-44 final margin.

stories.title: S. Korea wins first women's basketball gold medal in 12 years

en.title: S. Korea wins first women's basketball gold medal in 12 years
en.summary: South Korea defeated Japan 75-70 in the women's basketball final at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, capturing their first gold medal in this event since 2014.

en.summary: South Korea claimed its fourth consecutive gold medal in men's sabre team fencing at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, defeating Japan in the final.

en.summary: South Korea captured its first esports gold medal at the Asian Games by winning the fighting games event, defeating Japan in the final with a team competing in Street Fighter 6, Tekken 8, and The King of Fighters XV.

en.title: S. Korea Wins First Asian Games Gold Medal in Men's 3x3 Basketball
en.summary: South Korea won its inaugural Asian Games gold medal in men's 3x3 basketball by defeating Qatar 19-10 in the final at Nagoya.

stories.title: 'I felt embarrassed': Japan eSports whizz-kid, 11, wins Games gold

en.title: 'I felt embarrassed': Japan eSports whizz-kid, 11, wins Games gold
en.summary: An 11-year-old Japanese esports player won Asian Games gold in Puyo Puyo Champions, becoming the youngest competitor at the Aichi-Nagoya Games and in Japan's Asian Games history. He defeated opponents significantly older than himself in the competition.

stories.title: S. Korea adds two silvers in kayak sprint events at Asian Games

en.title: S. Korea adds two silvers in kayak sprint events at Asian Games
en.summary: South Korea earned two silver medals in men's and mixed kayak sprint events at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, completing its sprint canoeing campaign with two golds and two silvers total.

en.title: S. Korea wins bronze in women's synchronized 10m diving at Asian Games
en.summary: South Korea claimed its first diving medal at the Asian Games, winning bronze in women's synchronized 10-meter platform diving at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games with divers Kim Na-hyun and Moon Na-yun.
